g.text: FIT · PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT · PART 3.2 — CYCLE DESIGN
ENGINEERING DIAGNOSTIC INSTRUMENT · ANNUAL OPERATING SCHEDULE

svg.text: Cycle design isn't the stack you run — it's the rhythm you keep. Ride the loop: prepare, blast, cut, then a real 3–4-month recovery.
Keep the body fat in its gate. Reach for the dose only after food and training are spent. Push to a monitored peak — then pull all the way back.

g.text: the marker hierarchy — read, don't guess
· Cystatin C — true GFR for muscular people
· ALT / AST — with the 7-day no-training rule
· thyroid triad — GH speeds T4 → T3
· SHBG — a carrier, not an enemy
A marker deviates → the cycle bends or
The rest was nitrogen, glycogen & water — and muscle
Cycle design is a calendar of restraint — a coupled, gated, looping schedule,
▌ Two coupled tracks: the DRUG calendar rides on top of the slower FOOD calendar.
▌ The down-period is a TRUE 3–4-month quarter — clearing a cycle is not restoring your health.
▌ One hard line: never run a surplus above ~15% body fat. The trace must stay caged.
